For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rajesh Kumar Dubey, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Md. Nazir Ansari, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 21-07-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner is in custody since 22.03.2023 in connection with Town P.S. Case No. 219 of 2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120 (B) of the I.P.C. lodged on 21.03.2023 by the informant Rajesh Kumar.
As per the prosecution story, eleven candidates appeared for the post of Rural Postal Service and all were having education certificate of school of Bokaro.
On suspicion, inquiry was made and it was found that these are forged certificates provided from a Cyber Cafe, Chhapra Bazar for which each accused were going to pay Rs. 2,50,000/-.

Accordingly the F.I.R.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.40441 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he is a student having genuine certificate from Bihar School Examination Board and when the police rounded of all the persons, he also came into the net.
Learned APP opposes the prayer stating that he was also part of the accused, who was using his forged certificate.

sentences.text: Considering the fact that he is a student, who remained in custody since 22.03.2023, do not have criminal antecedent and will ultimately face the trial, this Court is inclined to extend him the privilege of bail with conditions.
With the aforesaid observations, the bail application is allowed.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Jagdish/Jyoti/-
